description: A shell was used as the entrypoint or exec point into a container with an attached terminal. Common when using kubectl exec in Kubernetes.

condition.condition: spawned_process and container and shell_procs and proc.tty != 0 and container_entrypoint and not container.image.repository in (busybox, registry.example.com/ops/toolbox)

details.output: A shell was spawned in a container with an attached terminal | user=%user.name process=%proc.name parent=%proc.pname command=%proc.cmdline terminal=%proc.tty container_id=%container.id image=%container.image.repository

name: Terminal shell in container
